problem.observed_behavior: The current-run SOL route-native observer remained alive but its artifact stopped refreshing for roughly 2.5 hours.
root_causes: Every refresh read and hashed the complete 1.5GB cohort ledger and complete 189MB SOL asset ledger, including unrelated historical runs.
Twenty-three exact archived L2 rows had the exchange clock 1-15ms ahead of the local receipt clock; the adapter treated any negative local-minus-exchange lag as corruption.
problem.research_impact: The priority-3 forward experiment was stale and the improvement digest could not update its SOL diagnosis.

technical_change.description: Snapshot only the exact source-run suffix from each append-only ledger, retain source offset/hash evidence, and define causal L2 availability as the later of local receipt and exchange time when negative skew remains within a 1000ms sanity ceiling.

evidence_update.interpretation: The earlier pending label predated a later explicit stream-gap record. The corrected refresh does not convert that uncertainty into a synthetic win or loss.

hypothesis_ledger.hypothesis: The stale artifact was caused by a dead observer.
hypothesis_ledger.evidence: The process remained alive and slept between resource-intensive full-prefix refreshes.

hypothesis_ledger.hypothesis: Exact-run suffix snapshots materially reduce refresh cost without changing the experiment identity.
hypothesis_ledger.evidence: The production-shaped refresh completed in 5.17 seconds and retained the exact v51 profile, run, fee, funding, public-event, and candidate contracts.

hypothesis_ledger.hypothesis: Small negative L2 receipt lag is corrupt evidence.
hypothesis_ledger.evidence: All 23 cases were bounded cross-clock leads of 1-15ms. Using the later timestamp is causal and more conservative than either earlier clock.

hypothesis_ledger.hypothesis: The first SOL one-blocker shadow attempt can produce an execution result.
hypothesis_ledger.evidence: An explicit stream gap overlaps its lifecycle, so its outcome remains technically unresolved.

change_proposal.recommendation: Retain the bounded exact-run observer and continue collecting the next independent SOL one-blocker episode; do not infer performance from the unresolved first attempt.
change_proposal.why_now: The previous observer architecture was too slow to support a continuous improvement loop and concealed newly arrived gap evidence.
change_proposal.evidence_reviewed: Live process sample, exact current-run ledger suffixes, public SOL L2/mark/gap archive, funding rows, frozen v51 config, production-shaped timing probe, and report-only replay output.
change_proposal.observed_problem_or_opportunity: A bounded reader makes the existing forward experiment operationally usable while retaining stricter causal evidence.
change_proposal.applicable_market_regime: all SOL regimes; the candidate itself remains tied to its exact Range Onset one-blocker condition
alternatives_considered: increase the interval while keeping full scans
bound reads to the exact source run and conservatively reconcile clocks
change_proposal.expected_upside: Fresh forward diagnostics with substantially lower memory and latency, without changing entries, exits, size, leverage, stops, or live order behavior.
change_proposal.main_risks_and_failure_modes: A reused run ID with a later configuration identity could create an unintended suffix boundary; a clock discrepancy above 1000ms aborts; an event gap can still leave a lifecycle unresolved.
change_proposal.validation_completed: TDD red/green for prior-run exclusion, 15ms conservative clock reconciliation, and 1001ms fail-closed behavior; relevant unit/integration suite and production-shaped probe passed.
change_proposal.validation_still_required: Observe at least two additional 120-second refreshes, verify monotonic source offsets and bounded memory, and reconcile the next independent candidate lifecycle.
change_proposal.success_metrics: Refresh completes well below the 120-second interval; source bytes and rows advance monotonically; no prior-run rows, duplicate attempts, synthetic gap outcomes, signer, or orders; process memory remains bounded.
change_proposal.failure_or_rollback_triggers: Any missed current-run row, source identity mismatch, duplicate attempt, non-monotonic prefix, refresh exceeding its interval, clock skew above the bound, or execution-capable dependency requires stopping the report-only observer and restoring the last good artifact.
change_proposal.confidence_level: high for the operational diagnosis and bounded-read improvement; low for SOL strategy edge because no execution is resolved

single_highest_value_next_investigation: Keep SP500 source-native both-side lifecycle collection at priority 1 while the repaired SOL observer independently waits for a later technically resolved one-blocker episode.
